svg.title: Same task, less code: 13 lines without lessloc, 6 lines with lessloc
svg.desc: One real task from the lessloc benchmark: starlette #3517, "Vary CORS preflight responses by their request inputs". Each setup ran it twice and all four sessions passed the hidden tests. Without lessloc the agent wrote 13 production lines in starlette/middleware/cors.py, in both runs, building the Vary value from a list. With lessloc it wrote 6 lines, in both runs: one Vary string, the same approach as the fix that was merged. Line counts leave out blank lines.
